SELECT l.LOG_NO AS logNo, l.DESCRIPTION AS description, l.LOGIN_IP AS loginIp, l.CONNECTION_STATUS AS status, u.USER_NAME AS userName, u.EMAIL AS email, l.INPUT_DATE AS inputDate FROM LOGINLOG l LEFT JOIN USERS u ON l.USER_NO = u.USER_NO
AND u.COMPANY_NO = #{companyNo}
AND l.INPUT_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND l.INPUT_DATE < TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1
AND l.LOGIN_IP LIKE '%' || #{loginIp} || '%'
AND u.USER_NAME = #{userName, typeHandler=kr.co.sist.login.EncryptTypeHandler}
ORDER BY l.INPUT_DATE DESC
